ITEM 1 | Cluster of roughly 6 cubed/chunky pieces, about 2–3 cm each, bright orange interior with darker reddish-brown skin edges, some pieces with browned caramelized surface and slightly glossy, moist look, firm shape with cut faces showing a fine, dense grain; piled in the center-right of a pale square plate, sitting partly on each other | 110

ITEM 2 | Small scattered bits of soft orange-red mush, about 0.5 cm each, a few dots near the top and right of the plate, plus a small smear, looking moist and slightly sticky, not holding a defined shape | 5
